---
title: "Triple-A explorer"
pagetitle: "Triple-A explorer: stats and percentiles"
description: "Swing decisions, contact quality, and pitching profiles for every Triple-A player, with league percentiles and what changed over the final two weeks."
page-layout: full
---

Every {{< meta baseball.season >}} Triple-A hitter and pitcher, ranked against the qualified league pool ({{< meta baseball.min_pa_qualified >}}+ PA or batters faced over a full season, prorated to games played earlier in the year). Percentiles are oriented so **higher is always better**: a low chase rate or a low walk rate shows as a high percentile. Move the date slider to see the league as it stood any week, or switch to the last 30 days. Click a column to sort and a name for the full player page. Switch **Numbers** to *Translated to MLB* to see each line run through the [Triple-A → MLB translation](/baseball/aaa-translation/): what the same numbers have typically become in the majors. Why the flags lean on swing decisions and velocity: [Two weeks of swing decisions tells you something. Two weeks of results doesn't.](/baseball/two-week-signal/)

::: {.note}
Model versions: [{{< meta models.aaa_translation >}}](https://github.com/matt-hardman15/sparvi-site/tree/main/models/baseball/aaa_translation/card.yml) ({{< meta models.aaa_translation_status >}}).
:::

```{=html}
<div class="explorer">
  <div class="controls" id="c"></div>
  <div class="controls" id="c2"></div>
  <div id="flags"></div>
  <div id="scatter" class="plot-host"></div>
  <p class="caption" id="scap"></p>
  <div id="t"><div class="loading">Loading…</div></div>
</div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const S = Sparvi, f = S.fmt, U = S.urlState;
  // Snapshot files carry what doesn't vary by date (age, final-14-day changes) as static fields.
  const files = { hitters: (win = "std") => S.loadSnap("snapshots_hitters_aaa", win),
                  pitchers: (win = "std") => S.loadSnap("snapshots_pitchers_aaa", win) };
  files[U.get("side", "hitters")]();  // start the data request now, in parallel with meta
  const meta = await S.load("/data/baseball/meta.json");
  const flagsP = () => S.load("/data/baseball/aaa_flags.json");  // only needed for a team at the final date
  const Q = meta.qualifiers, HIT_MIN = 100, dates = meta.snapshots.AAA.dates, LAST = dates.length - 1;
  const DEF = { side: "hitters", team: "", role: "all", window: "std", view: "aaa" };
  const st = { side: U.get("side", DEF.side), team: U.get("team", DEF.team), role: U.get("role", DEF.role),
               window: U.get("window", DEF.window), asof: U.get("asof"), q: "", view: U.get("view") === "mlb" ? "mlb" : "aaa",
               min: U.get("min") == null ? null : +U.get("min") };  // null = default (100 PA; pitch minimum by role)
  const idx = () => { const k = st.asof ? S.snapIndex(dates, st.asof) : LAST; return k < 0 ? 0 : k; };
  // Triple-A -> MLB translation: each number's fitted line from the translation article, applied to
  // whatever line is on screen (any date or window). Lines under the cohort minimum aren't translated.
  let fitsP = null;
  const fits = () => (fitsP ||= S.load("/data/baseball/translation_fits.json"));
  if (st.view === "mlb") fits();
  const teams = [...new Set((await files[st.side]()).players.map(p => p.series.std.team.filter(Boolean).slice(-1)[0]).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  const c = document.getElementById("c"), c2 = document.getElementById("c2");
  const roleHost = S.el("span", { class: "role-host" });
  function controls() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers";
    c.replaceChildren(...[
      S.el("label", {}, "Players", S.seg([["hitters", "Hitters"], ["pitchers", "Pitchers"]], st.side, v => { st.side = v; st.min = null; controls(); draw(); })),
      S.select("Team", [["", "All 30 clubs"], ...teams.map(t => [t, t])], st.team, v => { st.team = v; draw(); }),
      pitch ? roleHost : null,
      pitch ? S.number("Min. pitches", st.min, 25, v => { st.min = v; draw(); }, st.role === "all" ? "by role" : String(Q.AAA[st.role]))
            : S.number("Min. PA", st.min, 25, v => { st.min = v; draw(); }, String(HIT_MIN)),
      S.search("Find a player", "Name", v => { st.q = v; draw(); }, st.q)].filter(Boolean));
    c2.replaceChildren(S.dateSlider(dates, idx(), k => { st.asof = dates[k]; draw(); }).el,
      S.el("label", {}, "Window", S.seg(Object.entries(S.WINDOWS), st.window, v => { st.window = v; draw(); })),
      S.el("label", { title: "Translated to MLB: each number run through its Triple-A → MLB line (see the translation article)" }, "Numbers",
        S.seg([["aaa", "Triple-A"], ["mlb", "Translated to MLB"]], st.view, v => { st.view = v; draw(); })));
  }
  const final = () => idx() === LAST && st.window === "std";
  // Table minimum for hitters: 100 PA over a season, prorated, at least 1. (The percentile pool has its
  // own floor of 25, so early-season percentiles stay blank instead of resting on a few at-bats.)
  const hitMin = (fac) => Math.max(1, Math.round(HIT_MIN * fac));
  const pc = (key, label, fmt, title) => ({ key, label, fmt: (v, r) => fmt(v), heat: "pct", heatVal: r => r[key + "_pctl"], sortVal: r => r[key + "_pctl"], title });
  const hCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Hitter", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.id, r.name) },
    { key: "team", label: "Team", align: "l" }, { key: "age", label: "Age" }, { key: "pa", label: "PA" },
    pc("xwoba", "xwOBA", f.woba), pc("ev90", "EV90", v => f.num(v), "90th-percentile exit velocity"),
    pc("hard_hit_pct", "Hard-hit", f.pct), pc("chase_pct", "Chase", f.pct), pc("zone_contact_pct", "Z-Contact", f.pct),
    pc("k_pct", "K%", f.pct), pc("bb_pct", "BB%", f.pct),
    { key: "chase_delta", label: "Chase Δ14", fmt: f.pts, title: "Final 14 days vs season, percentage points (shown at the season's final date only)" },
  ];
  const pCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Pitcher", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.id, r.name) },
    { key: "team", label: "Team", align: "l" },
    { key: "role", label: "Role", align: "l", title: "SP starter · RP reliever · Swing, as of the selected date (see glossary)" },
    { key: "age", label: "Age" }, { key: "pitches", label: "Pitches", fmt: f.int }, { key: "bf", label: "BF" },
    pc("k_pct", "K%", f.pct), pc("bb_pct", "BB%", f.pct), pc("csw_pct", "CSW%", f.pct), pc("whiff_pct", "Whiff%", f.pct),
    pc("hard_hit_pct", "Hard-hit", f.pct), pc("xwoba", "xwOBA", f.woba),
    { key: "fb_velo", label: "FB velo", fmt: v => f.num(v) },
    { key: "fb_velo_delta", label: "Velo Δ14", fmt: v => f.signed(v), title: "Final 14 days vs season, mph (shown at the season's final date only)" },
  ];
  let tbl, side;
  const MLB_TIP = "Translated to MLB: the typical major-league value for a Triple-A line like this one (blank under the translation's minimum)";
  const host = document.getElementById("scatter");
  // One axis range per side x window x view, pooled over every snapshot date's qualified players
  // (S.stableDomain), so moving the slider moves the dots, not the axes.
  const domCache = {};
  function domains(snap, pitch, tr, X, Y) {
    const key = [st.side, st.window, st.view].join("|");
    if (domCache[key]) return domCache[key];
    const xs = [], ys = [];
    snap.dates.forEach((_, k) => {
      for (const r of S.snapRows(snap, st.window, k, pitch ? "pitches" : "pa").map(tr))
        if (r.qualified && r[X] != null && r[Y] != null) { xs.push(r[X]); ys.push(r[Y]); }
    });
    return (domCache[key] = [S.stableDomain(xs), S.stableDomain(ys)]);
  }
  async function draw() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers", i = idx();
    const snap = await files[st.side](st.window), std = await files[st.side]();
    const fac = S.prorate(meta, "AAA", i, st.window);
    const atI = pitch ? new Map(S.snapRows(std, "std", i, "pitches").map(r => [r.id, r])) : null;
    const isFinal = final();
    const mlb = st.view === "mlb", F = mlb ? await fits() : null, fit = F ? F[pitch ? "pitcher" : "hitter"] : null;
    const tr = r => { if (!fit) return r; const big = (pitch ? r.bf : r.pa) >= F.min_aaa, o = { ...r };
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fit)) if (k in o) o[k] = big && o[k] != null ? v.intercept + v.slope * o[k] : null;
      if (pitch) o.hard_hit_pct = null;  // no translation fitted for contact allowed
      return o; };
    const all = S.snapRows(snap, st.window, i, pitch ? "pitches" : "pa").map(r => tr({ ...r,
      role: pitch ? atI.get(r.id)?.role ?? r.role : undefined,
      chase_delta: isFinal ? r.chase_delta : null, fb_velo_delta: isFinal ? r.fb_velo_delta : null }));
    const roleOk = d => !pitch || st.role === "all" || d.role === st.role;
    const pre = all.filter(d => (!st.team || d.team === st.team)
      && (pitch ? S.qualifies(Q, "AAA", st.min, d.pitches, d.role, fac) : d.pa >= (st.min ?? hitMin(fac)))
      && (!mlb || (pitch ? d.bf : d.pa) >= F.min_aaa));  // translated view: only lines the translation covers
    if (pitch) roleHost.replaceChildren(S.roleFilter(st.role, v => { st.role = v; st.min = null; controls(); draw(); },
      { swing: pre.filter(d => d.role === "Swing").length }));
    const rows = pre.filter(roleOk);
    const shown = st.q ? rows.filter(d => (d.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(st.q)) : rows;
    if (side !== st.side + st.view) {
      const cols = (pitch ? pCols : hCols).map(c => mlb && c.heat ? { ...c, label: c.label + " ▲", title: MLB_TIP } : c);
      tbl = S.table(document.getElementById("t"), cols, { sortKey: pitch ? "k_pct" : "xwoba" }); side = st.side + st.view;
    }
    tbl.update(shown);
    U.set({ side: st.side, team: st.team, role: pitch ? st.role : "all", min: st.min, window: st.window, asof: i === LAST ? null : dates[i], view: st.view }, DEF);
    const fh = document.getElementById("flags");
    if (st.team && isFinal) {
      const flags = await flagsP();
      const roleOf = new Map(all.map(d => [d.id, d.role]));
      const fl = flags.filter(d => (pitch ? d.role === "pitcher" && roleOk({ role: roleOf.get(d.player_id) }) : d.role === "hitter") && d.team === st.team);
      fh.replaceChildren(fl.length
        ? S.el("div", { class: "flag-list" }, S.el("strong", {}, `${st.team}: what changed in the final 14 days (through ${meta.as_of})`),
            S.el("ul", { html: fl.map(d => `<li>${S.playerLink(d.player_id, d.name)}: ${[d.flag_discipline, d.flag_contact].filter(Boolean).join("; ")}</li>`).join("") }))
        : S.el("div", { class: "flag-list none" }, `No ${st.side} on ${st.team} crossed a change threshold in the final 14 days.`));
    } else fh.replaceChildren();
    const hi = st.team ? rows.filter(d => d.team === st.team) : (st.q ? shown : []);
    const base = all.filter(d => d.qualified && roleOk(d));
    const X = pitch ? "bb_pct" : "chase_pct", Y = pitch ? "k_pct" : "xwoba";
    const [xd, yd] = domains(snap, pitch, tr, X, Y);
    const bs = S.onScale(base, X, Y, xd, yd), hs = S.onScale(hi, X, Y, xd, yd);
    S.plot(host, w => Plot.plot({ ...S.plotDefaults(w), height: 320, grid: true, clip: true,
      x: { label: (pitch ? "Walk rate" : "Chase rate") + (mlb ? ", translated to MLB" : "") + " →", tickFormat: "%", domain: xd },
      y: { label: (pitch ? "↑ Strikeout rate" : "↑ xwOBA") + (mlb ? ", translated" : ""), tickFormat: pitch ? "%" : ".3f", domain: yd },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(bs.filter(d => !d._off), { x: "_x", y: "_y", r: 3, fill: "#c9c7c0", fillOpacity: 0.7 }),
        S.offScaleDots(bs),
        Plot.dot(hs, { x: "_x", y: "_y", r: 5.5, fill: "#eb6834", stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 1.2 }),
        hs.length <= 30 ? Plot.text(hs, { x: "_x", y: "_y", text: d => d.name.split(" ").filter(w => !/^(Jr\.?|Sr\.?|II|III|IV)$/.test(w)).slice(-1)[0], dy: -10, fontSize: 10.5 }) : null,
        Plot.tip(bs.concat(hs), Plot.pointer({ x: "_x", y: "_y", title: d => `${d.name} (${d.team}${pitch ? `, ${d.role}` : ""})\n${pitch ? `K ${f.pct(d.k_pct)} · BB ${f.pct(d.bb_pct)}` : `Chase ${f.pct(d.chase_pct)} · xwOBA ${f.woba(d.xwoba)}`}` }))] }));
    const when = `Through ${S.dateLabel(dates[i])}${st.window === "last30" ? ", last 30 days" : ""}`;
    const who = pitch && st.role !== "all" ? S.ROLES[st.role].toLowerCase() : "pitchers";
    const r = base.length > 2 ? S.corr(base, X, Y) : NaN;
    document.getElementById("scap").textContent = `${when}. ` + (pitch
      ? `Gray: every qualified Triple-A ${who === "pitchers" ? "pitcher" : who.replace(/s$/, "")}. Upper left is where you want to be: lots of strikeouts, few walks. Table: ${rows.length} ${who}, ${S.qualifierText(Q, "AAA", st.min, st.role, fac)}.`
      : `Gray: every qualified Triple-A hitter. Lower chase rates go with ${isNaN(r) ? "—" : r < 0 ? "better" : "no better"} xwOBA here (r = ${isNaN(r) ? "—" : r.toFixed(2).replace("-", "−")}), but the spread at any chase rate is wide. Table: ${st.min ?? hitMin(fac)}+ PA.`)
      + (hi.length ? ` Orange: ${st.team || "search matches"}.` : " Pick a team or search a name to highlight players.")
      + (rows.length === 0 && (pitch && st.role) === "SP" ? ` No pitcher has ${meta.role_rules.role_sp_min_starts}+ starts yet, the minimum for the starter role; early-season starters show as Swing.` : "")
      + (isFinal ? "" : " Δ14 columns and change flags describe the season's final two weeks, so they show only at the final date with the season-to-date window.")
      + (mlb ? ` ▲ columns are translated to MLB: the typical major-league value for this Triple-A line, from players who moved up. The table lists only lines with ${F.min_aaa}+ ${pitch ? "batters faced" : "PA"}, the translation's minimum, and each translation carries a wide range (see the article).` : "");
  }
  controls(); draw();
})();
</script>
```

::: {.note}
{{< meta baseball.season >}} regular season through {{< meta baseball.as_of >}}, in weekly snapshots. "Δ14" compares the final 14 days with the full season. Flags fire on chase rate ±5 pts or hard-hit rate ±10 pts (hitters, 30+ recent PA), fastball velocity ±1 mph (pitchers, 10+ recent BF), and walk rate +5 or whiff rate +7 pts (25+ recent BF). Definitions are in the [glossary](/glossary.html).
:::
